name: Question 13
problem: If $Y={7,14,21,…,154},$ which collection of subsets of $Y$ is a partition of $Y?$
worked_solution:
A partition of a set $Y$ is a collection of non-empty subsets of $Y$ where every element of $Y$ is contained in *exactly* one subset. 

Of the given collections, only ${{7,14,21},{28,35,42,…,84},{91,98,105,…,154}}$ is a partition.

The rest of the collections are not partitions:

- ${∅,{7,14,21,…,154}}$ is not a partition because the subset $∅$ is empty.

- ${{7,14,21,28,35},{42,49,56,63,70}}$ is not a partition because the elements $77,84,…,154$ do not appear in any subsets.

- ${{7,14,21,28,35,42,…,77},{91,98},{105,112,119,…,154}}$ is not a partition because the element $84$ does not appear in any subsets.

- ${{7,14,21,…,63},{56,63,70,…,154}}$ is not a partition because the elements $56$ and $63$ appear in multiple subsets.

Question 13
?

If Y={7,14,21,…,154}, which collection of subsets of Y is a partition of Y?

a
{{7,14,21,28,35},{42,49,56,63,70}}
b
{{7,14,21,…,63},{56,63,70,…,154}}
c
{{7,14,21,28,35,42,…,77},{91,98},{105,112,119,…,154}}
d
{∅,{7,14,21,…,154}}
e
{{7,14,21},{28,35,42,…,84},{91,98,105,…,154}}
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

A partition of a set Y is a collection of non-empty subsets of Y where every element of Y is contained in exactly one subset.

Of the given collections, only {{7,14,21},{28,35,42,…,84},{91,98,105,…,154}} is a partition.

The rest of the collections are not partitions:

  • {∅,{7,14,21,…,154}} is not a partition because the subset ∅ is empty.

  • {{7,14,21,28,35},{42,49,56,63,70}} is not a partition because the elements 77,84,…,154 do not appear in any subsets.

  • {{7,14,21,28,35,42,…,77},{91,98},{105,112,119,…,154}} is not a partition because the element 84 does not appear in any subsets.

  • {{7,14,21,…,63},{56,63,70,…,154}} is not a partition because the elements 56 and 63 appear in multiple subsets.
